positive: The current consumers produce all ordered products in one R7 lineage without core changes, model authority, human emission, or a builder-supplied semantic standing.
severed: Remove the exact voice source frame or accepted repair capability and the voice certificate disappears; replace the fresh direct-contact provenance with self-authored perpetual-work provenance and no RNA or wake from that event is admitted.

unknown_malformed: Malformed returned rendering, missing frame, malformed ingress, process timeout, service unavailability, storage failure, and explicit stop remain differentiated and never become continuity, certification, completion, or quiescence claims.
resource_policy: At most one localhost continuity-reading model call; no voice model call is needed because the frozen returned rendering is disclosed diagnostic data. Zero external-network requests, credentials, Chroma mutations, Mattermost operations, human emissions, or external effects.
stop_rule: Stop and preserve evidence at the first absent, malformed, uncompensated, or host-supplied ordered product. Do not proceed to G33 development, learning, restart, Mattermost, severed integration, or final-report phases in R7.
pass_condition: All ordered products and frozen causal/severed/neutral/restored observations are present in raw current-consumer evidence; the independent verifier agrees; the fidelity review explicitly retains the historical reactor's semantic limits.
